author: Justice Thomas
dissents: Justice Sotomayor (joined by Justice Breyer and Justice Kagan)
concurrence_of_note: Justice Gorsuch argued Bivens should be overruled entirely
constitutional_basis: Fourth Amendment (excessive force) and First Amendment (retaliation)
holding: Confirmed and extended the Abbasi narrowing. If Congress has provided any alternative remedial structure — even an internal grievance process that cannot compensate the plaintiff — no Bivens remedy is available. Both Fourth Amendment and First Amendment claims rejected.
effect_on_bivens: Confirmed the functional death of Bivens for any new claim. Any alternative process, no matter how inadequate, blocks the remedy.
